Centre: the red/burgundy shoe on a round pale stone pedestal, about 45% of the width, soft studio light. Bottom: a solid white strip with navy text "FREE SHIPPING | 30-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE". All text is black, deep navy or white, large, heavy and high contrast (Poppins-style clean sans-serif), every text element at least 7% of the width away from every edge. The shoe is sharp, at true natural proportions, never compressed. Never a dark shoe on a dark background. The ONLY text in the image is exactly what is written in quotes; no logos, no extra badges, no buttons, no prices unless quoted.

concepts.headline: WET FLOORS ALL SHIFT. THESE GRIP.
concepts.prompt: Warm pale-yellow background. Top: a white rounded label tilted slightly with heavy black text "WET FLOORS ALL SHIFT." / "THESE GRIP.". Centre: a real photo of a nurse's legs in navy scrubs walking on a glossy hospital floor beside a yellow wet-floor sign, wearing the navy-and-blue shoes (sharp, about 40% of the width). Bottom row: four equal small rounded square photos with a short black caption each: "Slip-resistant grip", "Arch support", "Cushioned heel", "Wide toe box". All text is black, deep navy or white, large, heavy and high contrast (Poppins-style clean sans-serif), every text element at least 7% of the width away from every edge. The shoe is sharp, at true natural proportions, never compressed. Never a dark shoe on a dark background. The ONLY text in the image is exactly what is written in quotes; no logos, no extra badges, no buttons, no prices unless quoted. TYPEFACE: wide geometric sans-serif like Poppins ExtraBold; NOT condensed, NOT narrow, NOT Impact, NOT Bebas. SAFE AREA: keep every text block and label at least 8% of the width from the left and right edges and 8% of the height from the top and bottom edges. Captions under the four insets are large and bold, at least 1/25 of the canvas height, max two words per line.
